 Cho Yi Hyun and Jinyoung star in romance-mystery Summer Vacation on Rakuten Viki
 What if your summer break turned into an actual K-drama? 📺 Cho Yi Hyun and Jinyoung star in Summer Vacation, coming soon to Rakuten Viki! Here's what we know so far 👇 #SummerVacation #KDrama #RakutenViki
 by 
 ASTIG PR 
 1 hour ago 1 hour ago 
 Advertisements 
 MANILA, Philippines (Oct 2026) – Imagine dreaming of living inside a K-drama, only to wake up and find yourself right in the middle of one. That fantasy becomes reality in Summer Vacation, a romance-mystery series coming exclusively to Southeast Asian viewers on streaming platform Rakuten Viki.
 Starring Cho Yi Hyun, Jinyoung, and Hong Ye Ji, the series blends youthful romance, unexpected encounters, and a touch of mystery set against the countryside of Upo-ri.
 A countryside getaway with a mystery twist
 The story follows an ordinary teenager looking for excitement during her summer break. Her quiet getaway takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with the heir of a prestigious traditional family. While his life appears picture-perfect from the outside, it comes with dark complications that surface as their relationship unfolds.
 With its picturesque rural setting, engaging plot, and a romance that is far from straightforward, Summer Vacation is set to be a must-watch for local K-drama fans.
 Where to watch
 Summer Vacation will be available exclusively on Rakuten Viki for audiences across Southeast Asia.
 Note: Official release dates and subscription pricing details have not yet been announced.
